title: Justice Ashok Bhushan demits office as NCLAT Chairperson after nearly five-year tenure
description: Justice Ashok Bhushan is set to demit office of the Chairperson of the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.Justice Bhushan had joined as Chairperson of NCLAT on November 8, 2021, for a period of 4 years, presiding over significant matters involving corporate law, insolvency, and competition statutes.He was later re-appointed as the Chairperson of NCLAT in 2025, and was to continue till he attains the age of 70 years on July 4, 2026.Born on July 5, 1956 in Uttar Pradesh's Jaunpur, Justice Bhu
